entry.title: Taylor Farms halts central Mexico sourcing after Cyclospora outbreak
entry.summary: The company will no longer harvest and process lettuce from the region between May and August, a period the CDC deems the cyclosporiasis season.

entry.title: Walmart to expand Wing drone delivery to Denver, Seattle
entry.summary: By next year, the retailer and partner Wing plan to offer aerial delivery from more than 270 stores across the country.

entry.title: NYC offers $5M to move deliveries away from peak hours
entry.summary: The city wants more commercial deliveries to be made at night to combat congestion, and the funding aims to help businesses achieve that goal.

entry.title: Panama Canal challenges drive shippers to Port of Los Angeles
entry.summary: High fuel costs are also pushing shippers and carriers to shift volume to the San Pedro Bay port to avoid longer transit times.

entry.title: Bed Bath & Beyond parent company taps AI to unify forecasting, replenishment
entry.summary: Neighborhood Intelligence is using Relex Solutions to reduce supply chain complexity across its brand portfolio, which includes The Container Store and Kirkland’s.

entry.title: Has Washington’s approach to manufacturing incentives really changed?
entry.summary: In addition to tariffs, the Trump administration has taken a more sector-specific approach to incentives compared to the Biden administration. A recent Department of Commerce report laid out the current tools available.

entry.title: Why Yum! Brands is deepening supplier relationships
entry.summary: The restaurant company has built a network of suppliers that are “ready to flex with us” if disruption strikes, Chief Supply Chain Officer Eric Craft said.

entry.title: CBP eyes earlier filing deadlines for low-cost imports, postal changes
entry.summary: The proposed adjustments could spur higher shipping costs and USPS capacity issues, but trade compliance would improve, the agency said.

entry.title: Best Buy pilots battery-powered vehicles at California distribution sites
entry.summary: The retailer deployed electric yard switchers as part of its efforts to curb emissions and will gauge future deployment potential across its supply chain.

entry.title: UPS’ Happy Returns comes to TikTok Shop
entry.summary: Pacsun and Everlane are among the retailers tapping into the new integration ahead of the post-holiday returns rush.
